_comment: Which moments become a short (lib/moments.mjs). Read anew for every history row, so a change here counts at once.
when: the game_history row that fires it. type, questId, levelNumber, itemTypeName must equal the row's; actor and target are 'human' or 'bot'.
The base followed is the human one: the actor's, or the target's when only the target is human.
before / after: seconds of the moment filmed before and after the row. The take is the whole of it.
text: the template the writer works from; shows: what the clip shows, for the writer. Never a name - the player is 'a player'.
cooldownMinutes: at most one short of this rule in that time. oncePerBase: never two of the same base.
chat: true also posts the portrait take, made small, into the planet chat (a Watch button, loaded on click).

camera.follow: the unit types the camera stays on, whatever else the base does (a unit inside a transporter is not looked for); maxRadius: how far apart they may be framed, default 25. Without camera the base's fight, else its middle.

rules.title: Leaves the noob island
rules.text: A new player just left the noob island: the builder loaded onto a transporter, the channel crossed, the builder set down on the mainland. Open-source RTS in a browser tab, no download and no account.
rules.shows: a real player's transporter crossing the channel from the noob island and the builder landing on the mainland
rules.event: a player left the noob island - their first crossing to the mainland

rules.title: Destroys a bot base
rules.text: A player takes down a whole bot base on the live server. Open-source RTS in a browser tab, no download and no account.
rules.shows: a real player's units destroying the last of a computer-controlled base
rules.event: a player destroyed a bot base

rules.title: Loses a unit to a bot
rules.text: Not every attack works out: a player's unit falls to a bot on the live server. Open-source RTS in a browser tab, no download and no account.
rules.shows: a real player's unit being destroyed by a computer-controlled base
rules.event: a player lost a unit to a bot
